description: This dataset is a benchmark problem for water resources simulation models, built on a multi-year simulation of the Upper Krishna River Basin in India in which water demands are cut as storage falls, a simple rationing policy that every model should reproduce. It contains the input data and solutions from Mike Hydro Basin, WEAP, HEC-ResSim and WEB.BM; the accompanying paper reports that Mike Hydro Basin and HEC-ResSim did not allocate water according to the prescribed rules. Nesa Ilich of Optimal Solutions Ltd. and Bernhard Becker of Deltares published it on Dryad in January 2026 as a spreadsheet with a supporting document, available as a free download under CC0. Coverage is one basin configuration used as a test case. Caveats: flows are steady-state per time step by design, so it tests allocation logic, not hydrology, and two further vendors' results were withheld. Simulation uses: verifying that reservoir operation and allocation models used in optimisation and network flow studies apply storage-dependent rules correctly. Related record: the Reservoir Assessment Tool (model-rat-reservoir-assessment-tool).
